text:
maria: flagging a pattern — when spot drains hit >20% of active pods we see on-demand floor spike, then drop, then spike again. looks like allocator oscillation.
aj: can you share a short timeline and sim numbers?
maria: synthetic load test at 2am PT. spot loss @2177777300 took out 6/30 nodes. autoscaler pushed 10 on-demand, then we reclaimed 7 after cool-down. repeat after 4m.
aj: ugh. so cool-down+min-floor isn't smoothing enough.
sanjay: hypothesis: our fallback policy is binary (use min-on-demand OR overflow-to-burst). need a graded throttle.
kevin: can we use probabilistic admit for burst lanes? like admit X% of new requests to burst until steady state. reduces step changes.
ellie: +1. also consider using eviction credits so tenants with recent evictions get deprioritized for a bit.
infra-bot: [autoscaler] triggered fallback pool attach: +10 ded instances for cluster redwood-west-1 at 2177777405
maria: sketched a config idea:
```
# probabilistic-floor config
min_on_demand: 0.15 # fraction of total capacity
burst_budget_ratio: 0.25
burst_admit_rate: 0.5 # 50% of new requests go to burst lanes when active
cooldown_s: 240
eviction_credit_decay_s: 600
```
aj: two nitpicks: make burst_admit_rate adaptive (based on running shortage) and make cooldown proportional to recent oscillation metric.
sanjay: we should simulate with weighted Poisson drain patterns (not just bulk kills). oscillation happens more with frequent small drains.
kevin: quick sim I ran on your config: reduced amplitude by ~60%, but 8% higher steady on-demand baseline. tradeoff is expected.
maria: acceptable if we cap steady baseline and show cost diff. can you share sim output, kevin?
kevin: dropping summaries to #eng-infra-sims, but short: cost +8% steady, p99 latency unchanged, evictions down 40%.
ellie: ops questions: rollout plan? feature flag + canary cluster + metrics dashboards: on_demand_floor, burst_admit_rate, oscillation_index.
maria: rollout plan: feature flag off by default -> enable in canary region (west-2) -> 24h smoke -> expand to low-traffic clusters -> 72h monitor -> global.
aj: add CDS alert: oscillation_index > 0.2 for 10m -> rollback flag.
sanjay: also add a chaos test to drain random 10% every 5m during canary to validate stability.
maria: action items: kevin to publish sim artifacts, aj to add alert, ellie to prep dashboard tiles, sanjay to write chaos test. i'll draft RFC for policy knobs.
kevin: on it. will post link soon. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks — if folks agree i'll flip feature flag to canary tomorrow 09:00 PT.
aj: fine by me.
ellie: +1
sanjay: go for it.
infra-bot: [note] canary feature flag scheduled: probabilistic_floor -> enabled in cluster west-2 at 2177864200
